ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel values across approximately 90% of the visible fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the lateral tips and median boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous mass covering both lobes; high-contrast white clusters localized at the far-left and far-right lateral apexes; diffuse white stippling present along the lower central margin and near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep pixel-depth; interior angle estimated between 45 and 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire length of the trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the superior trailing margin, sweeping upward towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, roughly circular white pixel clusters concentrated on the lateral extremities (tips) of both lobes, suggesting calcified colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions and white encrustations on the lateral tips of both fluke lobes; scattered white depigmentation spots across the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: White stippled patterning radiating from the median notch into the dark interior of the left and right lobes.
